hebrewText: וַ/יִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַ/יִּנָּ֤גֶף יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַ/יָּנֻ֨סוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְ/אֹהָלָ֔י/ו וַ/תְּהִ֥י הַ/מַּכָּ֖ה גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יִּפֹּל֙ מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף רַגְלִֽי

tokens.bdb: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction)
tokens.kjv: devour, eat, [idiom] ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).

tokens.bdb: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanation: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanationEn: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth

tokens.bdb: to push, gore, defeat, stub (the toe), inflict (a disease)
tokens.kjv: beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, [idiom] surely, put to the worse.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: a wound; figuratively, carnage, also pestilence
tokens.kjv: beaten, blow, plague, slaughter, smote, [idiom] sore, stripe, stroke, wound(-ed).

tokens.bdb: great (in any sense); hence, older; also insolent
tokens.kjv: [phrase] aloud, elder(-est), [phrase] exceeding(-ly), [phrase] far, (man of) great (man, matter, thing,-er,-ness), high, long, loud, mighty, more, much, noble, proud thing, [idiom] sore, ([idiom]) very.

tokens.bdb: properly, vehemence, i.e. (with or without preposition) vehemently; by implication, wholly, speedily, etc. (often with other words as an intensive or superlative; especially when repeated)
tokens.kjv: diligently, especially, exceeding(-ly), far, fast, good, great(-ly), [idiom] louder and louder, might(-ily, -y), (so) much, quickly, (so) sore, utterly, very ([phrase] much, sore), well.

tokens.bdb: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for H6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
tokens.ptLiteralWord: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet
tokens.enLiteralWord: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet
tokens.explanation: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet
tokens.explanationEn: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet
